rationale: Ashia is building AI-powered tools to automate research workflows and experimental validation, while Jonathan is a data science graduate student with hands-on experience in machine learning, Python, and TensorFlow—exactly the technical foundation research automation requires. intro_message: Ashia Livaudais, meet JONATHAN CHONG — Jonathan's building ML expertise in Python and deep learning frameworks while you're automating research workflows with AI; his hackathon track record and data pipeline work could be valuable as you scale SymbyAI's experimental validation tools.
